{{Quote|The Corellian maneuvered so the ''sun'' was in your eyes&hellip; and he and the Wookiee have you in a ''crossfire''!|Mystra, to a trio of individuals on Antipose|<ref name="0 ABY">"[[The Power Gem]]" is set after the events of {{Film|IV}} and before the [[Evacuation of Yavin 4]], therefore taking place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>}}
A '''star''' constituted a part of the [[Antipose system/Legends|Antipose system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Antipose]] and [[Antipose XII]] as well as the astronomical object [[Antipose IX]]. During a confrontation while visiting Antipose in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] positioned himself so that the planet's [[Star/Legends|sun]] would be shining into his opponents' [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], although the engagement was ultimately interrupted before any fighting could take place.

==Description==
A [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> was located in the [[Antipose system/Legends|Antipose system]], a part of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Falko Run]] linked it to the [[Falko system/Legends|Falko]] and [[Paulking system/Legends|Paulking systems]].<ref name="TEA Antipose" /> The star was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planets]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Antipose]]<ref name="UnstatedCanon" /> and [[Antipose XII]]&mdash;which had [[Color/Legends|violet]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]] and occupied the twelfth orbital position in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;as well as the celestial body [[Antipose IX]].<ref name="Gamer5" /> The Antipose system's orbital bodies included a yellow-colored astronomical object and a celestial body that appeared large and dark blue from the surface of Antipose. The sun itself appeared yellow when viewed from the surface of Antipose, looming large in the planet's sky.<ref name="PowerGem" />

==History==
[[File:SoloChewbaccaAntiposeFight-ThePowerGem.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Han Solo (rightmost) attempted to use Antipose's sun to gain a tactical advantage in a confrontation on the planet.]]
Antipose XII was already inhabited by [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[The Lando Calrissian Adventures (omnibus)|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] novel trilogy, of which ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'' is the second installment, to between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> while Antipose had come to be inhabited<ref name="PowerGem" /> at some point by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. In the latter [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="0 ABY" /> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] traveled to Antipose in search of one of the rare [[power gem]] artifacts. Shortly after stepping out of their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the pair was confronted by a [[Unidentified Human 1 (Antipose)|trio]] [[Unidentified Human 2 (Antipose)|of]] [[Unidentified alien (Antipose)|individuals]] who, being interested in acquiring the power [[Gemstone/Legends|gem]] themselves, attempted to intimidate any new potential rivals into leaving the planet. Subtly preparing for a [[lightfight]], Solo and Chewbacca positioned themselves so that they would have the three contestants in a crossfire, with Solo maneuvering so that Antipose's sun would be in his opponent's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="PowerGem" />

At that moment, [[Mystra]], an employee of the former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Raskar]] and enforcer of the local rules, arrived at the site on a [[Airspeeder/Legends|floater]]. She interrupted the confrontation, noting Solo's tactics, and subsequently ordered that the trio harassing Solo and Chewbacca leave the planet. Ordering the two smugglers onto the floater, Mystra then took them to Antipose's [[Antipose city|city]]. Later, while Chewbacca was engaged in an impromptu brawl with the planet's [[Unidentified gladiator|leading gladiator]] as part of Solo's plan to acquire the power gem for themselves, Antipose's sun, which shone directly overhead, was occulted by the star system's blue-colored astronomical object.<ref name="PowerGem" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star of the Antipose system was introduced in "[[The Power Gem]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Archie Goodwin]], penciled by [[Al Williamson]], and published between [[July 26]] and [[October 3]], [[1982]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> as part of the daily [[Star Wars (comic strip)|''Star Wars'' comic strip]] distributed by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] to major American and Canadian newspapers from [[1979]] to [[1984]].<ref name="Insider2012">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2012|The Empire Strips Back}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Antipose system, and therefore its sun, in grid square U-8.<ref name="TEA Antipose" />
